analysis: Integration of all 16 units found no concrete security regression. The PR removes console-ui leftovers after the console moved to darkbloom-platform. Changes are docs and tooling only: .githooks/pre-commit and pre-push, .github/dependabot.yml (npm entry for /console-ui), the lint-console job and its routing lane in .github/workflows/ci.yml, the console output in component-changes.yml, the Makefile ui-* targets, the AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and docs edits, scripts/ci-component-paths.py, docs-impact-rules.json, and the matching test scripts. The replayed source confirms the ci.yml and component-changes.yml edits: the console job and the console output are both removed, so no dangling needs.changes.outputs.console reference remains in those two files. No provider runtime, WebSocket (TB-002), attestation (TB-009/TB-011), key custody (A-002/A-003), prefix cache (T-041), fan helper (TB-010) or add-on hold (TB-012) code is touched. The scope statement already puts the consumer console out of scope. The removed pieces were all console-ui specific, so none map to a retained provider mitigation. The provider lanes keep SHA-pinned actions and read-only permissions. The remaining docs-impact rules still cover provider trust, cache storage and protocol fixtures. Residual unverified points, none a security finding: (1) whether branch protection still requires a lint-console check, (2) whether console-ui and its CI/hosting config are actually deleted elsewhere in the PR, (3) stale 'Retained Console' wording in docs/developer/build.md and navigation.md, and a broken fixture sentence in test.md (docs hygiene), and (4) whether scripts/ci-component-paths.py and the route tests agree with ci.yml. The removal of the Dependabot npm security-update entry applies to a directory the PR deletes, so the lost alerting is moot.
